base_profile.installation_type: Air Force Global Strike Command bomber installation / host-wing Air Force base
base_profile.host_or_major_command: Air Force Global Strike Command / 2nd Bomb Wing (host wing)
base_profile.primary_mission_summary: Barksdale Air Force Base is hosted by the 2nd Bomb Wing under Air Force Global Strike Command. The 2nd Bomb Wing conducts the installation's primary mission with three B-52H Stratofortress squadrons — the 11th Bomb Squadron (training), the 20th Bomb Squadron, and the 96th Bomb Squadron — providing flexible, responsive global combat capability and training Air Force Global Strike Command and Air Force Reserve B-52 crews, including the 307th Bomb Wing mission partners at Barksdale. The installation is also home to Air Force Global Strike Command headquarters and Eighth Air Force / Joint-Global Strike Operations Center.
mission_partners: Eighth Air Force / Joint-Global Strike Operations Center
base_profile.pcs_personality: Affordable, family-oriented, bomber-mission-heavy, and strongly connected to Bossier Parish versus Caddo Parish housing choices, West Gate / Shreveport-Barksdale Bridge access, school-zone verification, insurance and storm-maintenance costs, and long-term military housing demand.
base_profile.base_bluf: Barksdale is one of the more financially accessible Air Force housing markets in the country. For many qualified military families, buying can make more sense than renting, but BAH is a decision input, not a guarantee of affordability. Test insurance, neighborhood quality, school assignment by exact address, gate/report-time commute, and expected assignment length before signing.

installation_population.total: 14,581 (official Newcomers page published profile; not a live headcount)
installation_population.note: The current official Barksdale Newcomers page lists Population 14,581, Active Duty 5,039, Reservists 1,355, Total Military 6,394, Civilians 2,530, and Family Members 5,657. Those categories sum to 14,581. Treat this as a published installation profile, not a live 2026 census. MilitaryINSTALLATIONS rounds a similar mix to approximately 15,000 (over 5,000 active duty, 1,300 reservists, 5,500 family members, and 2,500 civilians) and separately notes approximately 25,000 retirees and family members living within a 50-mile radius; the retiree figure is a surrounding-area support statement, not on-installation population, and is not included here. The official 2nd Bomb Wing factsheet uses a different grouping — nearly 9,000 active-duty, Air Force Reserve, and civilian workforce plus about 6,000 dependents — and should not be added to the Newcomers total. Bossier City, Shreveport, metro, and parish civilian population figures are not installation population and are not used here. Do not add unlike categories into a fabricated total.

access_guidance.bluf: Barksdale currently operates four gates. Visitors without an accepted DoD access credential should use the West Shreveport Gate Visitor Center for temporary visitor passes, present REAL ID-compliant identification or another accepted credential, and verify current hours immediately before travel because gate and Visitor Center hours are time-sensitive.
current_posture: Official Gate Hours page: four gates — West/Shreveport (24/7 main gate and visitor-pass point at the end of the Shreveport-Barksdale Bridge), North/Bossier (scheduled; easiest lodging access), East/Industrial (weekday hours; East Reservation housing and search area), and Bodcau (East Reservation).
As of 7 May 2025, official Gate Hours guidance states REAL ID is required for Louisiana visitor passes and base access.
West Shreveport Gate Visitor Center standing published hours on the official Gate Hours page: 6:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. Monday-Sunday, phone 318-456-4984.
East Gate Visitor Center standing published hours: 6:00 a.m. to 5:45 p.m. Monday-Friday.
When Visitor Centers are closed, the West Gate writes visitor passes; official contact 318-456-3587.

MilitaryINSTALLATIONS currently lists Visitor Center hours as 6:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m., which conflicts with the official Gate Hours page. The installation Gate Hours page is the more specific source for standing hours.

An official Team Barksdale social-media staffing notice has previously announced reduced West Gate Visitor Center hours (weekday-only operations with weekend closures). Treat any social-media hour change as time-sensitive and verify against the official Gate Hours page and 318-529-2273 before travel.
Call the gate-status line 318-529-2273 immediately before travel. Flooding and other events have historically closed or rerouted gates.
access_guidance.access_questions_contact: West Shreveport Gate Visitor Center: 318-456-4984; after-hours visitor-pass questions: 318-456-3587; Gate Status Information Line: 318-529-2273; Base Operator: 318-456-1110

user_positioning.military_family_bluf: Prioritize school-zone verification by exact address, West versus North versus East/Bodcau gate logic, Bossier Parish versus Caddo Parish tradeoffs, BAH-plus-insurance monthly cost, and assignment length before signing a lease or purchase contract.
user_positioning.single_airman_bluf: Prioritize unaccompanied-housing eligibility, commute simplicity through the 24/7 West Gate, rental flexibility, and daily-service access in Bossier City or selected closer-in corridors.
user_positioning.realtor_bluf: The strongest Barksdale housing conversations are about affordability after insurance, commute through the actual report-time gate, Bossier versus Shreveport neighborhood screening, school assignment by address, and whether buying is justified by assignment length.
user_positioning.investor_bluf: Rental demand near Barksdale is influenced by bomber-mission stability, military turnover, comparatively low entry prices, and the need for practical family housing — not by metro-wide appreciation assumptions.

recommended_neighborhoods.pcsu_recommendation: Strong affordability and family-value candidate if the user accepts east-side gate planning and tests the actual report-time route.

commute_intelligence.commute_bluf: Barksdale commute pressure is usually more manageable than high-traffic military metros, but gate choice still matters. West Gate is the 24/7 default; North Gate helps lodging and some Bossier routes during published hours; East Gate and Bodcau matter for East Reservation and east-side housing. Times below are approximate and depend on exact address, gate, traffic, and report time.
commute_intelligence.overall_commute_posture: Generally favorable compared with high-traffic military metros, provided the household plans around published gate hours, the Shreveport-Barksdale Bridge, school traffic, and weather/flood risk.
primary_commute_factors: West (Shreveport) Gate 24/7 versus scheduled North, East, and Bodcau hours
I-20, I-49, and Arthur Ray Teague Parkway routing
School drop-off timing in Bossier Parish and Caddo Parish
Choosing by mileage instead of actual report-time commute
East Reservation versus main-base duty location
Heavy rain, flooding, and storm-related gate or road closures
primary_commute_risks: Assuming North Gate or East Gate will be open when the user actually reports
Sunday and after-hours arrivals that must use West Gate
East-side housing that looks close but depends on weekday-only East Gate hours
Bridge congestion during peak report windows
Weather-related delays and historic flood reroutes

commute_bands.label: Close-in
commute_bands.range: Approx. 0-20 minutes depending on gate, traffic, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: Best for users prioritizing proximity and daily convenience
commute_bands.watchout: Close-in South Bossier and selected Shreveport pockets still need property, school, and safety screening.

commute_bands.label: Balanced
commute_bands.range: Approx. 10-25 minutes depending on gate, traffic, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: Often the best balance between housing quality, services, and commute, especially in North Bossier
commute_bands.watchout: Gate choice and school drop-off timing can still change the real commute.

commute_bands.label: Lifestyle tradeoff
commute_bands.range: Approx. 25-40+ minutes depending on gate, traffic, and exact address
commute_bands.fit: May work for families wanting larger homes in Benton, Haughton, or selected farther corridors
commute_bands.watchout: Can become painful for early reporting, weekend duty, or frequent base errands if the chosen gate is closed.

gate_selection_logic: Start with the user's likely duty location (main base versus East Reservation).
Identify the most realistic 24/7 gate (currently West / Shreveport Gate).
Use North / Bossier Gate only during published hours, especially for lodging.
Use East / Industrial Gate only during weekday published hours for East Reservation and north-of-base housing.
Consider Bodcau for East Reservation / extended-hour patterns, not as a default newcomer gate.
Compare the commute during the user's actual report window.
Do not choose a neighborhood based only on mileage.
planning_guidance: Test the commute during the user's expected report-time window.
Confirm which gate best supports the user's duty location and day of week.
Compare North Bossier, Benton, Haughton, South Bossier, and selected Shreveport areas by route reliability, not only distance.
Build a West Gate backup plan for Sundays, after-hours, and visitor access.
Use commute plus all-in housing cost, including insurance, as the core PCSUnited decision screen.
commute_intelligence.user_instruction: Before signing a lease or contract, users should test the commute from the exact property address to the expected gate during the same time window they would normally report to work. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, and exact address.
commute_intelligence.pcsu_bluf: Barksdale commute pressure is usually manageable, but the best housing choice still depends on gate logic, report time, school traffic, and neighborhood fit — not pin-drop mileage.

bah_market_reality.bah_bluf: Barksdale should be modeled as a high-affordability military market. BAH is a decision filter, not a promise of affordability. Compare BAH against rent or mortgage, Louisiana insurance, utilities, maintenance, commute, debt, residual income, and assignment length.
bah_market_reality.overall_position: Strongly favorable for disciplined military buyers; renting remains practical for short assignments or tight residual income.
bah_market_reality.buying_power_summary: Lower home prices give many Barksdale families more realistic buying power than they would have in larger military metros, but insurance, humidity, storm exposure, and older-home maintenance can erase a headline-price advantage.
bah_market_reality.renting_summary: Renting remains practical, especially for short tours, unaccompanied personnel, or households still screening neighborhoods. Strong affordability can make buying attractive only when debt, savings, insurance, and expected assignment length support it.

BAH without dependents vs estimated rent

Residual monthly income after expenses and housing

bah_market_reality.base_tab_message: Show BAH as a decision filter, not a promise of affordability. The Base tab should push users into the PCSUnited financial calculator when insurance, debt, or residual income looks tight even if the purchase price looks low.
bah_market_reality.pcsu_strategy_note: Barksdale should be modeled as a strong affordability market, but PCSUnited should still test each user's rank, BAH, debt, savings, credit score, insurance quotes, PCS timeline, and exit plan before calling buy versus rent.

family_readiness.family_bluf: Barksdale can be a strong family PCS location when the household chooses the right neighborhood, verifies school assignment by exact address, plans childcare early, and protects against hidden ownership costs such as insurance and humidity-related maintenance.

school_guidance.on_base_option: Current 2nd FSS School Liaison page: students living on the main base are listed as zoned for Waller Elementary, Rusheon Middle School, and Bossier High School; students living on the East Reservation are listed as zoned for Platt Elementary, Princeton Elementary, T.L. Rhodes Elementary, Haughton Middle School, and Haughton High School. Official Getting Here / School Information pages instead mention Waller Elementary for Historic housing and Kerr Elementary for Eastside housing, plus Rusheon Middle and Bossier High. Treat those lists as research starting points only.
school_guidance.school_liaison_address: 801 Kenney Avenue, Suite 2102, Barksdale AFB, LA 71110
school_guidance.school_zone_warning: Always verify school assignment by exact residence before signing a lease or purchase contract. On-base School of Choice language on official pages applies to eligible active-duty base residents in Bossier Parish up to school capacity and is not a guaranteed assignment. Off-base assignment is determined by physical residence in Bossier Parish or Caddo Parish.
school_guidance.nearby_school_district_note: Common off-base research includes Bossier Parish Schools and Caddo Parish Schools. The School Liaison page directs families to each district's locator tools. Do not assume a preferred elementary such as Kerr Elementary from older newcomer language is the assigned school.

childcare_guidance.cdc_note: Current 2nd FSS directory lists Child Development Center hours 6:00 a.m.-6:00 p.m., CDC East at 424 Kenney Avenue (318-456-1081) and CDC West at 411 Fairchild Avenue (318-456-2735). Availability, waitlists, and eligibility should be verified through MilitaryChildCare.com or current 2nd FSS Child and Youth Services resources.
childcare_guidance.youth_program_note: Youth Programs are listed at 425 Kenney Avenue, 318-456-3448. Family Child Care coordinator is listed at 413 Curtiss Road, 318-456-9688, 2fss.barksdale.childcare@us.af.mil. Confirm current waitlists and hours before making a housing decision around childcare.

medical_guidance.urgent_care: Official Urgent & Emergency Care page: Barksdale does not offer urgent or emergency care services. Call 911 for emergencies. Nurse Advice Line 1-800-TRICARE (874-2273).
medical_guidance.medical_warning: Do not assume on-base emergency capability. Plan a civilian emergency-department backup. Verify clinic availability, referrals, pharmacy procedures, and the second-Wednesday monthly training closure directly with official medical sources.
medical_guidance.general_hours_note: Appointments Monday-Friday 7:30 a.m.-4:30 p.m.; closed second Wednesday of every month for training. Family Health walk-ins 8-10 a.m. and 1-2:30 p.m.

family_readiness.spouse_employment_note: The Shreveport-Bossier market is smaller than large coastal metros. Spouse-employment plans should consider licensing/credentialing, childcare waitlists, commute through the actual gate, and whether a dual-commute household still fits Bossier versus Caddo geography.

Drive the commute from target neighborhoods during the actual expected report window, including a West Gate backup.

pcs_watchouts.title: Gate and Visitor Center hours can change
pcs_watchouts.message: Use the official Gate Hours page and 318-529-2273 immediately before travel. As of 2026-09-16, West/Shreveport Gate is listed 24/7; North/Bossier Gate 6:00 a.m.-5:45 p.m. weekdays and 8:00 a.m.-2:00 p.m. Saturday, closed Sunday; East/Industrial Gate 5:45 a.m.-5:45 p.m. weekdays, closed weekends; Bodcau 4:30 a.m.-11:59 p.m. Monday-Thursday and 4:30 a.m.-1:00 a.m. Friday-Sunday. Visitor Center hours conflict across official sources.

pcs_watchouts.title: Visitor access procedures are security-sensitive
pcs_watchouts.message: West Shreveport Gate is the published visitor-pass point. REAL ID is required for visitor passes and base access as of 7 May 2025 per the official Gate Hours page. VCC 318-456-4984; after-hours visitor-pass questions 318-456-3587. A public BDOC number was not published.

pcs_watchouts.title: Distance is not the same as commute
pcs_watchouts.message: Neighborhoods should be compared by realistic gate access, duty location, bridge traffic, school drop-off timing, and report-time windows. Times are approximate and depend on gate, traffic, and exact address.

pcs_watchouts.title: School assignments are residence-specific
pcs_watchouts.message: Verify school assignment by exact property address with Bossier Parish or Caddo Parish tools and the School Liaison. Official pages disagree on some East Reservation elementary names. On-base School of Choice is not a guaranteed assignment.

pcs_watchouts.title: BAH is not the full affordability picture
pcs_watchouts.message: Do not assume a low purchase price automatically means a comfortable payment. Compare rent or mortgage against income, debt, utilities, Louisiana insurance, maintenance, savings goals, and assignment length.

pcs_watchouts.title: Published population is a Newcomers profile, not a live census
pcs_watchouts.message: The official Newcomers page publishes 14,581 total with 5,039 active duty, 1,355 reservists, 2,530 civilians, and 5,657 family members. That is not Bossier City, Shreveport, or metro population. MilitaryINSTALLATIONS' ~25,000 retirees within 50 miles are not installation population. The 2nd Bomb Wing factsheet uses a different workforce/dependent grouping.

pcs_watchouts.title: No on-base urgent or emergency care
pcs_watchouts.message: Official 2nd Medical Group guidance: Barksdale does not offer urgent or emergency care. Call 911 for emergencies and use the Nurse Advice Line 1-800-TRICARE (874-2273) for non-emergency guidance.

pcs_watchouts.title: On-base housing is not automatically the best financial answer
pcs_watchouts.message: Off-base prices around Barksdale can look attractive, but insurance, commute, schools, pets, waitlists, and assignment length still decide the better path. Compare on-base Hunt housing against rent and buy.

pcs_watchouts.title: Humidity, storms, and insurance can erase a cheap-house advantage
pcs_watchouts.message: Louisiana insurance, flood/drainage, roof/HVAC age, and humidity-related maintenance should be in the monthly model before a buy recommendation.

realtor_intelligence.best_client_positioning: Lead with affordability after insurance, BAH fit, commute through the actual report-time gate, Bossier versus Shreveport screening, and school assignment by address. Barksdale clients need practical strategy more than luxury positioning.
